title: Pepin Debone Chicken.flv
summary: Jacques Pepin demonstrates deboning a whole chicken, quickly and with complete control. It is a short, wordless-feeling technique demo that shows a skill most cooks never learn.
why: HN calls it the single best cooking video on the internet and suggests it as a skill worth practicing for an hour.

quote.text: Pepin's chicken deboning video is the best cooking video that has ever or will ever be put on the Internet
